description: Na₂MgScF₇ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Imma space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six F atoms. There are two shorter (2.26 Å) and four longer (2.55 Å) Na-F bond lengths. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a distorted body-centered cubic geometry to eight F atoms. There are four shorter (2.46 Å) and four longer (2.80 Å) Na-F bond lengths. Mg is bonded to six F atoms to form MgF₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent MgF₆ octahedra and corners with four equivalent ScF₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 36-44°. There are two shorter (1.94 Å) and four longer (2.01 Å) Mg-F bond lengths. Sc is bonded to six F atoms to form ScF₆ octahedra that share corners with four equivalent MgF₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 44°. There are four shorter (2.03 Å) and two longer (2.06 Å) Sc-F bond lengths. There are three inequivalent F sites. In the first F site, F is bonded to three Na and one Sc atom to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing FNa₃Sc tetrahedra. In the second F site, F is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Mg, and one Sc atom. In the third F site, F is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to two equivalent Mg atoms.
